mira_s: quick triage note from onboarding Zenkai-v1 (fp16 baseline) -> int8/q4 bring-up. fp16 detok looks fine but int8 builds show token splits in mixed vertical JP + Arabic‑Indic numerals. small repro below.

lee_w: paste repro and tokenized views?

mira_s: repro input (vertical subtitle style w/ furigana and Arabic‑Indic digits):
```










(Real text simplified): "\u300a\u300b6\u0667\u0668\u306b\u5411"
```
(OK that paste is noisy; canonical input: "太郎\u300aたろう\u300bは \u0666\u0667\u0668 に向かった。")

expected detok: "太郎『たろう』は ٦٧٨ に向かった。"
int8 detok (wrong): "太郎『たろう』は 6 78 に向かった。"

note: Arabic‑Indic cluster \u0666\u0667\u0668 became latin/partial split `6 78` and furigana wrapper tokens fractured.

oscar_r: tokenizer version pinned? packaging differences?

mira_s: tokenizer v2026-04-02 pinned in both runs. I inspected tokenized outputs:
fp16 tokenized: [太郎, 『, たろう, 』, は, \u0666\u0667\u0668, に, 向かった, 。]
int8 tokenized: [太郎, 『, たろう, 』, は, 6, 78, に, 向かった, 。]

ioscar_r: that indicates vocabulary entries for Arabic‑Indic sequences missing in int8 artifact. check pack logs.

mira_s: pack step log: "WARN: pruning multi-codepoint tokens: ranges 0x0600-0x06FF: 4 entries removed". attaching snippet to ticket ML-5310.

nina_l: ugh this is the same class of bug we saw in previous q4 brings. pack-artifact pruning removed rare multi-codepoint tokens (emoji-ZWJ, ruby clusters, Arabic‑Indic runs). We need both immediate mitigation and a packaging policy change.

oscar_r: immediate: block int8 rollout and push patched artifact with pruning disabled. long-term: pack-artifact must validate token coverage for codepoint classes used in multilocale evals. add unit test that tokenizes a representative set (CJK + furigana, Arabic‑Indic, ZWJ emoji families) and fails build if coverage drops.

mira_s: quick repro rebuild with `--no-prune` fixed the detok and tokenization matches fp16. I'll upload artifacts and smoke diffs to ML-5310: https://redwood.test/triage/ML-5310. evals-bot: posted regression metric: multilocale/vertical-detok BLEU -5.7 (int8 vs fp16) and token-drift +12.3%.

evals-bot: Regression alert & ticket ML-5310 linked to eval run 1767551234.

nina_l: follow-ups: 1) add pack-artifact preflight that compares token counts for codepoint buckets; 2) produce a "prune-candidates" human-readable file during build so reviewers can audit; 3) include vertical-subtitle + mixed-numeral smoke in nightly. I'll draft the PR.

ioscar_r: I'll coordinate rollback with eng-runtime. mira_s, please attach minimal failing sample and exact pack log lines to ML-5310.

mira_s: done. assigning: oscar -> rollback, nina -> pack tests & PR, lee -> release gate hold, mira_s -> artifact + smoke plots.

lee_w: ack. holding int8 rollout until multilocale suite passes.

oscar_r: rolling back now. :arrow_backward:

mira_s: thanks everyone. small note: we should also add a unit that verifies tokenizer wheel contents when `--strip-embeddings` or size-optimizations are used; packaging should never silently drop multi-codepoint tokens that our evals exercise.

nina_l: agreed. PR incoming. :white_check_mark:
